'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Iran]]ian [[Supreme Leader of Iran|supreme leader]] [[Mojtaba Khamenei]] issues his first public message since [[2026 Iranian supreme leader election|his election]] in which he says that Iran should continue blocking the [[Strait of Hormuz]] and advises neighboring countries to close [[List of American military installations|American military bases]] in their territory. Khamenei also vows to "avenge the blood of our [[Martyrdom in Iran|martyrs]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c4gqjyk0vx3t?post=asset%3A0bcdc28a-0230-4947-aa0d-2cdaf3ab93fe#post (BBC News)] [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2026-03-12/us-israel-iran-war-iranian-leader-mojtaba-khamenei-statement (''Los Angeles Times'')]
****German shipping company [[Hapag-Lloyd]] says that projectile ​fragments ​hit the [[Liberia]]-flagged container vessel ''Source Blessing'' ⁠near the ​Strait. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/projectile-fragments-hit-hapag-lloyd-container-vessel-near-strait-hormuz-2026-03-12/ (Reuters)]
****[[Oman]] orders the evacuation of vessels from the [[Mina Al Fahal]] oil port. [https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oman-Evacuates-Key-Oil-Port-as-Iran-War-Intensifies.html (Oil Price)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
****An Iranian strike hits [[Energy in Bahrain|fuel]] storage tanks at a facility in [[Muharraq Governorate]], [[Bahrain]]. [https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?id=bahrain-says-firefighters-contain-blaze-after-iranian-strike-on-fuel-tanks&date=12/03/2026 (Qatar News Agency)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****[[Kuwait International Airport]] is targeted by several drones, causing material damage but no injuries. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/iran-war-live-iranian-drones-strike-kuwait-international-airport-no-casualties-11205363 (NDTV)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
****The [[Saudi Ministry of Defense|Saudi defense ministry]] announces the interception of two missiles and the destruction of seven drones. [https://qna.org.qa/en/news/news-details?id=saudi-defense-ministry-two-missiles-intercepted-seven-drones-destroyed&date=12/03/2026 (Qatar News Agency)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on the Kurdistan Region]]
****A [[French Armed Forces|French soldier]] is killed and six others are injured in an [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|Iranian drone]] attack on a [[military base]] in [[Erbil]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/drone-attack-wounds-least-six-french-soldiers-base-iraqs-makhmour-erbil-governor-2026-03-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2026/3/13/%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%B8-%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A9-6-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%88%D8%AF-%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****Eight people are killed and 31 more injured by an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] on the [[Ramlet al-Baida]] beach in central [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. Seven more people are also killed in other attacks in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/12/israeli-double-tap-strike-hits-displaced-on-beirut-seafront-kills-eight (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Hezbollah]] launches over 200 rockets and 20 [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|UAVs]] at [[Northern District (Israel)|northern Israel]], injuring two people.  [https://www.timesofisrael.com/hezbollah-fires-at-least-150-rockets-at-north-iran-launches-missiles-in-integrated-operation/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**At least 20 people are killed in an [[airstrike]] targeting a [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] building in [[Akashat]], Iraq. [https://www.skynewsarabia.com/middle-east/1858294-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%84-20-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B4%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B9%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A (Sky News)]

'''Business and economy'''

**The [[United States]] [[United States Department of the Treasury|treasury department]] issues a temporary license permitting the delivery and sale of [[Russia]]n [[Petroleum industry in Russia|oil and petroleum products]] already loaded onto vessels before March 12, easing sanctions on such shipments until April 11 amid rising global energy prices. [https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/lufthansa-strike-vc-b2936962.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel]]
**[[Iceland]] and the [[Netherlands]] announce they will both intervene on the side of [[South Africa]] in the [[International Court of Justice]]'s genocide case against Israel. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2597264/iceland-netherlands-join-icj-genocide-case-against-israel (''The Express Tribune'')]
*[[Arctic policy of Canada]], [[NATO Arctic Sentry]], [[Polar Icebreaker Project]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]] announces nearly [[Canadian dollar|CAN$]]35 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]25.7 ‌billion) in funding to strengthen [[Canada]]'s [[Arctic]] infrastructure, including upgrades to [[Canadian Armed Forces|military]] facilities and the construction of new [[icebreaker]]s to expand the country's operational capacity in the region. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260313-with-new-ships-canada-aims-to-be-icebreaking-superpower (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Brazil–United States relations]], [[Arrest of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**[[Brazil]]ian [[Supreme Federal Court]] justice [[Alexandre de Moraes]] denies a request by imprisoned former [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] to receive a visit from American diplomat [[Darren Beattie]], ruling that the meeting falls outside the diplomatic purposes stated in Beattie's [[Visa policy of Brazil|visa]] authorization. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-top-diplomat-raises-concerns-over-trump-aides-planned-visit-bolsonaro-2026-03-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Cuba–Holy See relations]]
**[[Cuba]] announces plans to release 51 prisoners following discussions with the [[Holy See]], stating that the detainees have served most of their sentences and demonstrated good conduct. [https://www.indopremier.com/ipotnews/newsDetail.php?jdl=Cuba_announces_release_of_51_prisoners_after_talks_with_Vatican__official&news_id=1723448&group_news=ALLNEWS&taging_subtype=CUBA&name=&search=y_general&q=CUBA,%20&halaman=1 (AFP via Indo Premier)]
*[[Hungary–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Hungary]] returns two seized [[Armored car (valuables)|armored cars]] to [[Ukraine]] but retains approximately US$82 million in cash and gold as authorities investigate suspected [[money laundering]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/hungary-returns-seized-ukrainian-bank-vehicles-withholds-cash-gold-2026-03-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iran–Thailand relations]], [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
**[[Thailand]] summons [[List of ambassadors of Iran to Thailand|Iran's ambassador]], demanding an apology and an explanation for the attack on the bulk carrier {{ship|MV|Mayuree Naree|2007|6}} in the waters of the Strait the previous day. [https://www.bernama.com/en/news.php/?id=2533661 (BERNAMA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Old Dominion University shooting]]
**Two people are killed, including the perpetrator, and two other people are critically injured in a [[school shooting]] at [[Old Dominion University]] in [[Norfolk, Virginia|Norfolk]], [[Virginia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/12/us/old-dominion-university-shooting-virginia (CNN)] [https://www.wavy.com/news/local-news/old-dominion-university-issues-active-threat-at-constant-hall/ (WAVY-TV)]
*[[Crocus City Hall attack]]
**A [[Russia]]n [[military court]] sentences 19 people for their involvement in the [[Terrorism in Russia|terrorist]] attack at the [[Crocus City Hall]] in [[Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast|Krasnogorsk]], [[Moscow Oblast]], in 2024. Fifteen of those are sentenced to [[Life imprisonment in Russia|life in prison]] while the other four are given between 19 and 22 years in [[Prisons in Russia|prison]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0j5lx75vg3o (BBC News)]
*[[Human rights in Indonesia]]
**Two unidentified men assault and injure the deputy director of [[Commission for Missing Persons and Victims of Violence|KontraS]], an [[Indonesia]]n [[human rights]] organization, in an [[acid attack]] in [[central Jakarta]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-activist-acid-attack-andrie-yunus-5993076 (AFP via CNA)] [https://en.tempo.co/read/2092448/jakarta-police-probe-acid-attack-on-kontras-activist-andrie-yunus (Tempo English)]
*[[Temple Israel synagogue attack]]
**The perpetrator is killed and 31 others are injured in a shooting and [[vehicle-ramming attack]] at the [[Temple Israel (West Bloomfield, Michigan)|Temple Israel]] [[synagogue]] in [[West Bloomfield Township, Michigan|West Bloomfield Township]], [[Michigan]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/michigan-synagogue-shooting-03-12-26?t=1773355657241 (CNN)]
*[[Sanctions during the Venezuelan crisis]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] at [[The Hague]] dismisses an investigation into whether U.S. sanctions against [[Venezuela]]n officials qualify as crimes against humanity. [https://apnews.com/article/icc-venezuela-sanctions-belarus-69050a392fbe77023cab37b3195afbfb (AP)]
*A [[rabbi]] is seriously injured in a stabbing in [[Ramat Gan]], [[Israel]], as local police suspect a terrorist motive. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/man-seriously-wounded-in-ramat-gan-stabbing-police-suspect-terror-motive/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] drops charges against five soldiers accused of [[Sexual and gender-based violence against Palestinians during the Gaza war#Leaked video of gang rape|raping a Palestinian prisoner]] at the [[Sde Teiman detention camp]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-war-palestinians-prison-abuse-b11e5f0639b7fe51c5ea101f4b320f56?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Nepalese general election]]
**The [[Nepal]]ese [[Election Commission (Nepal)|election commission]] releases the official results of the recent [[Elections in Nepal|election]], with [[Balen Shah]]'s [[Rastriya Swatantra Party]] winning 182 seats in the 275-member [[House of Representatives (Nepal)|House of Representatives]]. The result gives the party a [[Majority government|majority]] in the House and places it two seats short of a [[supermajority]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/nepals-rsp-party-of-balendra-shah-wins-majority-election-commission/article70736058.ece (AFP via ''The Hindu'')]
*[[President of Poland|Polish president]] [[Karol Nawrocki]] announces that he will veto [[Law of Poland|legislation]] enabling [[Poland]] to access [[Euro|€]]43.7 billion (US$50.3 billion) in [[European Union]] loans under the [[Common Security and Defence Policy|Security Action for Europe]] program to fund [[Polish Armed Forces|military]] spending. [https://www.reuters.com/business/polish-president-vetoes-eu-defence-loan-bill-2026-03-12/ (Reuters)]
